Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add value_mappings feature for SQL MCP and production cleanup

This commit adds the value_mappings feature to the SQL MCP server, allowing automatic
resolution of user-provided values to exact database values for low-cardinality columns.

Key Features:
- SQL MCP now accepts value_mappings array parameter for case-insensitive value matching
- Automatically replaces user values with exact database values before query execution
- Supports multi-word values (e.g., "closed won" -> "Closed Won")
- Works with complex queries including JOINs, CTEs, CASE statements, and aggregations

New Services:
- azure_sql_client.py: Azure SQL database client with Azure AD auth
- rbac_service.py: Row-level security and access control
- table_discovery_service.py: Schema discovery and caching
- value_matching_service.py: Fuzzy value matching with embeddings

Function Definitions:
- sql_query_function.json: Updated with value_mappings parameter
- get_schema_function.json: New schema discovery tool
- list_tables_function.json: List available tables
- list_columns_function.json: List columns with distinct values

Production Tests:
- test_real_schema.py: Tests with actual Azure SQL schema
- test_complex_value_mappings.py: Complex query validation
- test_orchestrator_end_to_end.py: End-to-end orchestrator tests
- VALUE_MAPPINGS_TEST_RESULTS.md: Comprehensive test documentation

Repository Cleanup:
- Removed deprecated graph and interpreter MCPs
- Removed old frontend React application
- Updated .gitignore for logs, temp files, and local configs
- Added pyproject.toml for Python packaging

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Remove deprecated components and update core services for SQL-only orchestrator

This commit removes all deprecated graph and interpreter MCP components, streamlining
the codebase to focus solely on the SQL MCP orchestrator with value_mappings support.

Removed Components:
- Frontend React application (deprecated)
- Graph MCP server and related files
- Interpreter MCP server and related files
- Old deployment documentation
- Deprecated test files for removed MCPs

Core Service Updates:
- SQL MCP server: Added value_mappings parameter handling with emoji-free logging
- Discovery service: Updated for SQL-only MCP registration
- Orchestrator: Streamlined for single SQL MCP agent
- Auth provider: Enhanced Azure AD authentication
- Fabric client: Updated configuration and error handling
- Config: Added support for Azure SQL connection strings

Updated Prompts:
- planner_system.md: Comprehensive value_mappings documentation with examples
- Removed graph and interpreter agent prompts

Updated Tests:
- test_sql_mcp.py: Enhanced with value_mappings test cases
- init_data.py: Updated test data for realistic Azure SQL schema

Documentation:
- README.md: Updated with value_mappings feature and deployment instructions
- scripts/README.md: Updated test documentation

Requirements:
- requirements.txt: Updated dependencies for Azure SQL and MCP
- orchestrator/requirements.txt: Streamlined for SQL-only operation

This simplification makes the codebase production-ready with a clear focus on
text-to-SQL capabilities with intelligent value mapping for low-cardinality columns.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
